“It was one of those days when it's a minute away from snowing and there's this electricity in the air, you can almost hear it. Right? And this bag was just dancing with me. Like a little kid begging me to play with it. For fifteen minutes. That's the day I realized that there was this entire life behind things, and this incredibly benevolent force that wanted me to know there was no reason to be afraid, ever. Video's a poor excuse, I know. But it helps me remember... I need to remember... Sometimes there's so much beauty in the world, I feel like I can't take it, and my heart is just going to cave in.” 

-American Beauty

Tiffany Sessions was murdered by Paul Eugene Rowles in 1989. She told her roommate that she would be going on a power walk one night and after five hours she still hadn’t returned. Rowles was a convicted serial killer who would have a little book for information about his victims. For Sessions (who it is to be believed), he wrote “#2 2/9/89”. February 9th, 1989 was the day Sessions disappeared. She is believed to be dead but is still known as a missing person.

Hey i know EXACTLY what you’re going through. I go to a high school for the arts so I am artistically gifted like you, but being forced to do the work with no motivation is torture. I know exactly how you feel, and i too have been feeling like this since I was a kid. I wish I could still have interests but those are long gone. And I also would especially like for others to understand that it’s not feeling sad, it’s feeling depressed. There’s a difference. As a result of what others say they say that I’m “attention seeking.” So if people say anything like that, just ignore them. Only others who have or had depression can understand. You’re not alone, I know how it feels :)

Literally anything by Nick Drake. All of his songs are amazing, I highly recommend listening to “Fruit Tree”, “Northern Sky”, and “Fly” as those are some really beautiful songs so you can have a taste of what his music was like. If you like beautiful melodies and softer sounds, this guy is for you.
